messages:
alex: Heads-up — seeing sustained tail latency in eu-west dedicated pool since 02:10 UTC. p95 token latency jumped ~3x, evictions spiking. Noticing a single tenant causing large KV scan/egress bursts.

maria: Which pool id? can you paste the alloc stats?

alex: pool eu-west-dedicated-42. Quick dump: 
```
preempt_count: 132
kv_cache_evictions/sec: 480
egress_bytes/s: 1.2Gb
active_slots: 320/400
```

jia: @alex can we apply a short-term proxy rate-limit before we split capacity? Regex-based rate limits are cheap and reversible.

sam: +1. Proxy throttle protects SLOs but customer may reject heavy throttling — they're doing valid work. Alternative: move their heavy flows to a fractional slice (preemptible) and bill the delta.

maria: cross-region fallback (eu-west -> eu2) will add egress and complexity. Prefer local mitigations first: either egress shaping for that tenant or a small ded. carveout with strict egress cap.

alex: proposed quick plan: create stitchback slice for tenant t-84f3 with tight egress_shaper=10mbps and kv_quota=0.2, and simultaneously set a proxy rate limit rule for that tenant as safety. Run canary 90m.

ops-runner: ran a replay on last 48h traces with that config. Summary: warm-slot churn -63%, p95 token latency -23%, estimated monthly cost delta: +$7k if we provision dedicated vs +$900 if we keep proxy throttle and stitchback slice. Will attach full numbers to ticket.

jia: sounds reasonable. Need quicktoggle flags and alerts. If p95 goes above target we should auto-drain the tenant and escalate.

sam: I'll open INF ticket and tag SRE. Also add cost tags so Finance can track the extra $7k if we choose provision.

alex: rollout steps I'll run (owning):
1) create stitchback slice: 10 slots, egress_shaper=10mbps, kv_quota=0.2
2) deploy proxy rule: `rate_limit tenant=t-84f3, limit=20rps, burst=50`
3) enable telemetry: `metric:dedicated.p95.tokens`, `metric:kv.evictions`
4) monitor 90m; rollback if p95 > 300ms or kv_evictions/sec rises.

maria: can we also add a soft-fallback policy to route new allocations to spare pool if stitchback saturates? avoids immediate on-call pages.

ops-runner: added auto-fallback hook into canary: if stitchback egress saturates >85% for 5m, reroute new heavy allocs to preemptible slice.

sre-bot: FYI — no active incidents in eu-west. If p95 breaches configured threshold after rollout, SRE auto-remediate will trigger drain for tenant t-84f3.

jia: thanks. Alex, ping here when you start so we can watch dashboards. :thumbsup:

alex: starting at 03:08 UTC. will post results in 30/90 min marks.
